Read out of saint.gr's line for 24 Δεκεμβρίου, «Αγία Ευγενία η Οσιοπαρθενομάρτυς», with the rank word left off.

Read out of the Охридски пролог’s first heading for 24. децембар ст. ст., „Преподобна мученица Евгенија и други с њом.“ — «Преподобна» is the rank `venerable` and «мученица» the rank `martyr` the folder carries, and «и други с њом» is the company and no part of her name, so the bare forename is what is left. The book gives her no by-name. Measured before it was written and it has no other holder in the corpus.

source.text: Calendarul zilei, Doxologia (doxologia.ro), 24 decembrie — «Sfânta Muceniță Eugenia»
saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 24ης Δεκεμβρίου — «Αγία Ευγενία η Οσιοπαρθενομάρτυς»

attestations.note: The life page `/3222/` heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 24 Δεκεμβρίου εκάστου έτους», the same day the folder already keeps for the Romanian, and it is the same woman: the virgin martyr of Rome who fled her parents' match in man's clothes and was beheaded. The Greek gives her the compound rank Οσιοπαρθενομάρτυς, venerable virgin martyr, which the folder's `types` already cover with martyr and virgin. Its head gives «(; - 262)» while its first sentence says she «έζησε στο δεύτερο μισό του 3ου αιώνα μ.Χ.», and **a `dates` object is drafted on the stated century and not on the head's year**, because the two do not sit together and the sentence is the page's own prose. The page names her father Philip, her mother Claudia, her brothers Avitas and Sergios, and the Roman official Aquilinas her parents meant her for; her father is this day's new folder `philip-father-of-eugenia`, and the mother and the brothers are not on the calendar and get none. Alexandria and Rome are named and no coordinate is proposed; a portion of her relic is at the monastery of Boura of Megalopolis, which is not drafted. An apolytikion and a kontakion are printed with their ἦχος and their automela, both naming her, and both are taken. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence.

source.text: Православни подсетник (pravoslavno.rs), Охридски пролог за 06.01.2026 (24. децембар ст. ст.) — „Преподобна мученица Евгенија и други с њом.“

attestations.note: The day’s first entry and the fuller of the two. Identified on the whole dossier and on the same menologion day the Romanian and the Greek already keep her: the daughter of Филип, eparch of all Egypt, born at Rome, who visited the Christians driven out of Alexandria and received their faith with her whole heart, fled her parents with her two faithful eunuchs, was baptised by the bishop Елије, entered a MEN’S monastery in man’s clothing and took the monastic habit there, and was accused by the rich woman Мелантија whom she had healed and who then tried to draw her into bodily sin not suspecting she was a woman — which the book itself compares to Potiphar’s wife and the chaste Joseph. THE YEAR AND THE DAY BOTH NEED SAYING. The entry closes «Мачем је посекоше 25. децембра 262. године у Риму», and the Lord had appeared to her in prison and told her she would suffer on the very day of His Nativity. SO THE BOOK GIVES HER DEATH-DAY AS 25 DECEMBER AND KEEPS HER ON THE 24TH, and the row goes on 24 December, the day of the page read, because that is where this book prints her and a death-date in a body is not a feast. The 25th is recorded here and in the life and is written in no feast field. THE YEAR WAS NOT WRITTEN: 262 is a flat year where this folder holds «second half of the 3rd century», 251 to 300, read off saint.gr as `traditional`, and the two do not contradict — 262 lies inside that half-century. Narrowing an interval to the newest book’s flat year is a reading of the sources together and not of the newest one, so `dates` is UNTOUCHED, the 262 is recorded, and it is an author question. `types` untouched: «Преподобна» is `venerable` and the folder carries `martyr` and `virgin` — a grade not added, for the same reason, and reported. WHAT THE ENTRY ADDS: that she so cleansed her heart by a self-chosen struggle that she received from God the grace of healing the sick; that the eparch had all the monks chained and thrown into prison with her; that she revealed herself to her own father at the trial as his daughter; that she brought pagans and girls in particular to the true faith at Rome and foretold Василија’s beheading; that the temple of Diana fell down and was destroyed by her nearness; that they threw her first into water and then into fire and God saved her from both; and that after her death she appeared to her mother in great glory and comforted her. THE HEADING’S «и други с њом» IS FILLED IN BY THE BODY and makes three rows in this same commit, on `basilla-martyr-24-december`, `protas-companion-of-eugenia` and `hyacinth-companion-of-eugenia`; `philip-father-of-eugenia` is named in the body, dies for the faith in Alexandria before she goes to Rome, and was DELIBERATELY LEFT WITHOUT A ROW because «с њом» does not reach him — this day’s one open question. Мелантија, Елије and Теренције hold no folder and take nothing. The four `related` rows the folder already carries stand and nothing was added. The Prologue prints no hymn (8 October 2026).

death.note: saint.gr: «Η Αγία Ευγενία η Οσιοπαρθενομάρτυς έζησε στο δεύτερο μισό του 3ου αιώνα μ.Χ.» The same page's head gives «(; - 262)», which the stated half-century contains but does not confirm; the sentence is followed and the head's year is recorded here rather than drafted. The folder held no `dates` before this.

hymns.text: Θείου Πνεύματος τῇ ὑμνωδίᾳ, φῶς προσέλαβες θεογνωσίας, Εὐγενία Χριστοῦ καλλιπάρθενε· καὶ ἐν ὁσίων χορείᾳ ἐκλάμψασα, ἀθλητικῶς τὸν ἐχθρὸν ἐθριάμβευσας. Μάρτυς ἔνδοξε, Χριστὸν τὸν Θεὸν ἱκέτευε δωρίσασθαι ἡμῖν τὸ μέγα ἔλεος.

source.text: saint.gr, Ἀπολυτίκιον, Ἦχος γ’, Θείας πίστεως — the first hymn on the page of «Αγία Ευγενία η Οσιοπαρθενομάρτυς», and it names her.

english.text: By the hymnody of the divine Spirit you took to yourself the light of the knowledge of God, Eugenia, fair virgin of Christ; and shining out in the choir of the venerable, you triumphed over the enemy as a contender. Glorious martyr, entreat Christ our God to grant us his great mercy.

hymns.text: Τὴν τοῦ κόσμου πρόσκαιρον, φυγοῦσα δόξαν, τὸν Χριστὸν ἐπόθησας, τὸ εὐγενές σου τῆς ψυχῆς, ἀδιαλώβητον σῴζουσα, Μάρτυς θεόφρον, Εὐγενία πανεύφημε.

source.text: saint.gr, Κοντάκιον, Ἦχος δ’, Ἐπεφάνης σήμερον — on the page of «Αγία Ευγενία η Οσιοπαρθενομάρτυς», printed as hers and naming her; it plays on her name, εὐγενές against Εὐγενία.

english.text: Fleeing the passing glory of the world, you longed for Christ, keeping the nobility of your soul unmarred, God-minded martyr, all-praised Eugenia.
